chapter: Pranks, the Mingus fight and Duke's writing
title: Itching powder on Duke and the Step Brothers
summary: He put itching powder on Duke's watch and in a Step Brother's clothes; the dancers got even with his shirt.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Well, I used to play, you know, those things, like with Duke Ellington while we was at the Howard Theatre. I mean at the Apollo Theatre. I went to Duke; the curtain was getting ready to go up for the start of the show, and I went to Duke; I said, 'What time is it, Duke?' and at that time he had a watch, and while I was looking, I saw this powder in his hand, around his wrist. So when he started playing, all of a sudden, he started playing with his left hand and started rubbing his hand, and he was wondering, what the devil that was, and he found out, sooner or later, that it was itching powder, you know?
I don't know. He figured it out -- I used to play tricks on a lot of people. Like, for the Four Brothers, the dancers, you know? The ones that were with us?

I put some itching powder. I came early that morning; I was in Boston, and I put the itching powder -- I went in their dressing room, and one of his pants, you know? Drawers or whatever they called them; I put some of that itching powder in them, so when they went upstairs to dance, oh, my Lord -- the red fellow, the one we used to call 'Red', that was the lighter one; oh, he was dancing and squawking, and I said I didn't know anything, but they figured it was Tizol doing it. So they didn't say anything to me.

The next day, I came to the theatre and I went to put on my tuxedo shirt, and as soon as I put my arms in the sleeve, I know there's noticed something wrong. So I took it off, and instead of shaking it off or changing the shirt, and it was almost time for me to go onstage, so I just shook it off and I got my hands in there anyhow. Oh, and I was on the stage itching like mad!
So did that stop your tricks?
